_doc: Stage registry read by pipeline.py. ARRAY ORDER IS RUN ORDER: add a stage by inserting one entry where it belongs; pipeline.py needs no edit.
Fields (all validated on load; an unknown or missing field is a hard error):
name           unique stage id used by --only / --skip / --describe
description    one line, shown by --list --describe and the docstring-style help
applies        always | has_netlist | has_gen_script:<file> | netlist_has_block:<NAME>   (has_netlist = projects/<id>/gen/netlist.py exists)
interpreter    kicad (KiCad's bundled Python, can import pcbnew) | system (the Python running pipeline.py)
argv           arguments after the interpreter; tokens {project} and {boardgen} (= tools/boardgen) are substituted
design_stage   true = writes/regenerates the design itself; blocked by the fab-output guard unless --force; never cached
inputs         globs (relative to the repo root, {project} substituted) whose CONTENTS decide whether the stage must re-run
outputs        globs the stage writes; a cached skip also requires them to be present and untouched since the last run
env            environment variables that change the stage's behaviour; if any is set the stage is never cached
no_cache_reason  required whenever inputs is empty: why this stage must always run (a stage with no inputs is never cached)
Cache rules (pipeline.py): key = sha256(stage entry + resolved argv + toolchain + input file contents); a stage is skipped as 'cached' only if
its key and its outputs are identical to the last SUCCESSFUL run in projects/<id>/.pipeline_cache.json. Failures are never cached. --no-cache forces.

stages.name: lint
stages.description: Design-rule lint of netlist.py (decoupling, polarity, LED resistors, shorts, pad/pin existence, registry use). Pure Python, <1 s.

stages.name: parts
stages.description: Registry parts vs live/cached LCSC + EasyEDA: MPN, footprint geometry, package, stock, freshness.
stages.no_cache_reason: answer depends on live supplier stock and data age (network + clock), which no input file captures

stages.name: sch
stages.no_cache_reason: design stage: regenerates the design files other stages read and must stay an explicit, --force-guarded act

stages.name: sch-check
stages.description: Netlist compare (kicad-cli export vs netlist.py) plus ERC.

stages.name: place
stages.description: Footprints, board outline, silkscreen and pre-routed links.
stages.no_cache_reason: design stage: rewrites the board file in place

stages.name: route
stages.no_cache_reason: design stage, and Freerouting is nondeterministic: identical inputs do not give identical copper, so a skip would hide a different result

stages.name: finish
stages.no_cache_reason: design stage: rewrites the board file in place

stages.name: check
stages.description: DRC including schematic parity - the gate before fab.

stages.name: ir
stages.description: Design IR (out/design.json): parts, nets, board geometry from netlist.py + .kicad_pcb; netlist-vs-board net cross-check; JSON-Schema validated.

stages.name: electrical
stages.description: Electrical rules (EL-ABSMAX, EL-CONTENTION, EL-OD-PULLUP) over out/design.json via the derived electrical model; NOT_JUDGED shown, never hidden.

stages.name: review
stages.description: Design review (kicad-happy schematic/PCB/EMC analyzers + waivers.json): decoupling distance, EMC, power tree.

stages.name: outputs
stages.description: Gerbers, drill, BOM, CPL, STEP, schematic PDF and renders.
stages.no_cache_reason: release artefact: always regenerated on request (3D models and KiCad libs it embeds are not enumerable as inputs)

stages.name: lvs
stages.description: Independent connectivity of the fab zip itself (gerbers + drill), diffed against netlist.py.

stages.name: fabreport
stages.description: MANUFACTURING.md: size, layers, holes, parts, order-form answers. Read-only on the board.

stages.name: connections
stages.description: CONNECTIONS.md: every pin of every part and where its copper goes, in plain words.

stages.name: pinmap
stages.description: Firmware pin map vs netlist cross-check (enabled by a FIRMWARE block in netlist.py).

stages.name: spice
stages.description: Transient LTspice run of the whole board plus expected-vs-measured (enabled by a SPICE block in netlist.py).

stages.name: webview
stages.description: Export GLB, cache icons, build manifest, onboard to the viewer (works for any .kicad_pcb).
stages.no_cache_reason: the viewer server rewrites manifest.json/io_map.json live and onboard.py keeps its own GLB/icon caches, so a pipeline-level skip would be unsafe
